provenance.note: Operator-maintained pairing recipes, not a certified catalog. A recipe pre-fills a plausible EEP/platform/channel starting point for the 'declare profile' step; it is never proof of a device's actual identity. Every row it creates is still recorded with eep_source=manual, exactly like a hand-typed EEP. 'support' reflects what this repository can decode today, independently of how well the product itself is documented.

evidence: NodOn ASP-2-1-x0 User Guide (EnOcean Alliance product page)
NodOn ASP-2-1-x1 User Guide (EnOcean Alliance product page)
nodon_asp_2_1_01.notes: Instantaneous power and accumulated energy metering per EEP D2-01-0B is not decoded by this release; the row still works as a plain switch.

nodon_sin_2_2_01.notes: D2-01-12 is already implemented for the UBID1507C; this recipe applies the same decoder to NodOn's own hardware, not just the Ubiwizz module.

nodon_sin_2_rs_01.notes: This repository has no cover platform; D2-05-00 is not decoded and this recipe is never offered in the picker. Listed for documentation only.

evidence: NodOn EnOcean wall switch product page
nodon_cws_2_1_01.notes: A plain RPS rocker row already decodes F6-02-01/02 without declaring an EEP (RPS carries none); this recipe is informational and declares nothing new.

evidence: Eltako FT55 datasheet; the EnOcean Alliance reference rocker design licensed to multiple vendors
eltako_ft55.notes: Same note as CWS-2-1-01: RPS carries no EEP, so this recipe is informational and declares nothing new.
